questions.question: Define desizing and state its importance in textile processing. / [CO1]
questions.solution_html:

  • Answer- Desizing is the process of removing the sizing agents—like starch or other polymers—that

  • Key importance of desizing: Improves absorbency, Ensures even dyeing and printing, Enhances fabric
  • handfeel

questions.question: Define fabric dyeing and explain its importance as a stage in textile production. / [CO3]
questions.solution_html:
• Define fabric dyeing and explain its importance as a stage in textile production.
  • Answer- fabric dyeing or piece dyeing, is the process of applying color to fully woven or knitted fabrics
  • after their production. This stage is indispensable in textile manufacturing, as it provides desigh
  • flexibility by enabling color decisions later in the work flow. The process typically unfolds in three key
  • steps: pre -treatment ( scouring and bleaching ), dyeing (immersing the fabric in a dye bath, post
  • treatment (dye fixation).
questions.source_exam: Third Semester MGU-UGP(Hons.) Regular Exam Oct 2025

• Explain the main components and step-by-step process of screen printing.
  • Answer-screen printing is a popular printing technique used to apply designs on to the fabric and other
  • materials using a stencil ( called a screen ). Ink is pushed through the screen ’s open areas using a
  • squeegee, transferring the design onto the surface below.
  • Process of screen printing
